name: ruflo-mods-manager
description: A pane for ruflo's Claude Code mods (function hooks, ADR-406): /mods lists each ruflo-family mod with where it is enabled, whether Claude Code can resolve it and what ruflo-mods' trust gate makes of it, draws which mod hooks which engine event and the init chain, and charts doctor health. Enables or disables a mod through the ruflo CLI; read-only otherwise. Installing other mods stays with /plugin.

cli.title: ruflo CLI
cli.description: How the pane reaches the ruflo CLI. auto (default) uses the project's node_modules/@claude-flow/cli when present, else the locally cached @claude-flow/cli without touching the network; npx may download it; ruflo and claude-flow use a global install.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh (s)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the open pane re-reads ruflo mods list and status, 10 to 600 seconds. Nothing polls while the pane is closed.

animate.title: Animate the health pulse
animate.description: Animate the health view's pulse (refresh times on the real clock). Off draws it still.
